sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 Dealbook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 Dealbook 峰会的现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 现场直播精选访谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, what really happened to Tyree Nichols, who died after he was violently beaten by police in Memphis?
sentences.zh: 今天，在孟菲斯被警察暴力殴打后死亡的泰里·尼科尔斯究竟遭遇了什么？

sentences.en: An encounter captured in a series of videos released over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 这场遭遇被周末发布的系列视频记录了下来。

sentences.en: My colleague, Southern Bureau Chief Rick Rojas, is in Memphis, where he's been piecing together the story.
sentences.zh: 我的同事、南方分社社长里克·罗哈斯正在孟菲斯，他一直在拼凑这个故事。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月30日，星期一。

sentences.en: Rick, tell us about Tyree Nichols, the man at the center of this story.
sentences.zh: 里克，请给我们讲讲泰里·尼科尔斯，也就是这个故事的核心人物。

sentences.en: So Tyree Nichols was a 29-year-old man who lived in Memphis.
sentences.zh: 泰里·尼科尔斯是一名29岁的男子，住在孟菲斯。

sentences.en: He was black, and his mother described him as living a kind of simple, pleasant life.
sentences.zh: 他是黑人，他的母亲形容他过着一种简单、愉快的生活。

sentences.en: Every day, like clockwork, he would wake up at 8.30, and he would go to the same Starbucks and get the same drink.
sentences.zh: 每天雷打不动，他会在8点30分醒来，去同一家星巴克买同样的饮料。

sentences.en: You know, he had been working for about nine months at a FedEx facility in the city, and he seemed to be doing well on all accounts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他在该市的一家联邦快递设施工作了大约九个月，各方面表现似乎都很好。

sentences.en: He loved his skateboard, and he was a regular at Shelby Farms, which is this really sprawling park just outside Memphis.
sentences.zh: 他热爱滑板，是谢尔比农场的常客，那是孟菲斯郊外一个非常广阔的公园。

sentences.en: He'd go almost every day, either for skating or to photograph the sunset.
sentences.zh: 他几乎每天都要去，要么去滑板，要么去拍摄日落。

sentences.en: He was an amateur photographer, and he had a four-year-old son, and he just seemed like someone who was like a typical 29-year-old,
sentences.zh: 他是一名业余摄影师，有一个四岁的儿子，看起来就像是一个典型的29岁年轻人，

sentences.en: who was finding his way and building a life for himself.
sentences.zh: 在摸索中前行，为自己构建生活。

sentences.en: And so I think for his family, that's what has made this all the more staggering.
sentences.zh: 所以我想对他的家人来说，这也是最让人感到震惊的地方。

sentences.en: They didn't see him as someone who would have any kind of encounter with the police.
sentences.zh: 他们从没想过他会与警察产生任何形式的冲突。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, I want to talk about that encounter.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想谈谈那次冲突。

sentences.en: We, of course, now have a video of it, but for several weeks, we didn't.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们现在有了当时的视频，但在好几个星期里，我们并没有。

sentences.en: And there was a fair bit of mystery around what exactly had happened.
sentences.zh: 当时对于究竟发生了什么，存在相当多的谜团。

sentences.en: So I'm wondering, Rick, if you could take us back to what first happened to Tyree Nichols and walk us through how this all unfolded as we experienced it in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，里克，你能带我们回到泰里·尼科尔斯最初遭遇了什么，并带我们梳理这一切是如何在我们实时经历中展开的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, this case has been shrouded in a lot of mystery before the video came out.
sentences.zh: 是的，在视频曝光之前，这个案件一直笼罩在重重迷雾之中。

sentences.en: At the beginning, what we know came from a police statement.
sentences.zh: 最初，我们所了解的信息来自一份警方声明。

sentences.en: So on January 7th, Tyree Nichols gets pulled over by the police in the southeastern corner of the city.
sentences.zh: 因此，在1月7日，泰里·尼科尔斯在城市东南部被警察拦下。

sentences.en: It was around 8.30 p.m., and it was on suspicion of reckless driving.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是晚上8点30分，理由是涉嫌危险驾驶。

sentences.en: And at that point, there was some sort of physical confrontation between Tyree Nichols and those officers.
sentences.zh: 在那时，泰里·尼科尔斯与这些警员之间发生某种身体冲突。

sentences.en: He then took off on foot.
sentences.zh: 随后他步行逃跑。

sentences.en: The officers caught up with him, and then there was a second confrontation.
sentences.zh: 警员追上了他，然后发生了第二次冲突。

sentences.en: And somewhere during the course of those confrontations, he sustained a level of injury that was so severe that he needed to be hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 在这些冲突的过程中，他受了重伤，严重到需要住院治疗。

sentences.en: He was unconscious for three days, and then he died on January 10th.
sentences.zh: 他昏迷了三天，然后于1月10日去世。

sentences.en: So in the immediate aftermath, all we know is that a pretty routine-sounding traffic stop has ended in Tyree Nichols' death.
sentences.zh: 所以在紧接着的事后阶段，我们所知道的全部就是，一起听起来很常规的交通拦车检查最终以泰里·尼科尔斯的死亡告终。

sentences.en: And so, of course, the question becomes, did these officers use excessive force?
sentences.zh: 因此，问题自然而然变成了：这些警员是否过度使用武力？

sentences.en: So what happens in the next few days?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来几天发生了什么？

sentences.en: So multiple investigations are launched.
sentences.zh: 因此，多项调查随即展开。

sentences.en: First, there's an internal inquiry by the Memphis Police Department.
sentences.zh: 首先，孟菲斯警察局进行了内部调查。

sentences.en: And then the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation was called in to look at the basics of the case to try to understand whether or not the officers had used excessive force
sentences.zh: 接着，田纳西州调查局被请来调查案件的基本情况，以试图弄清楚警员是否使用了过度武力，

sentences.en: and whether that use of force reached a criminal level.
sentences.zh: 以及这种武力的使用是否达到了刑事犯罪的级别。

sentences.en: And then after that, federal prosecutors also said that they would be launching a civil rights investigation into what happened as well.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，联邦检察官也表示，他们将对事件展开民权调查。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So everyone in law enforcement is taking this pretty seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以执法部门的所有人都对此相当重视。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And in a way to acknowledge that, city officials announced pretty early on that they wanted to be transparent
sentences.zh: 为了表达这一点，市政府官员很早就宣布他们希望保持透明，

sentences.en: and they planned to release whatever video footage they collected as part of their investigation to show the public what happened during that traffic stop.
sentences.zh: 并计划公布他们在调查过程中收集的任何视频监控，向公众展示那次交通拦车检查期间发生的事情。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And then on January 20th, 10 days after Tyree Nichols died, the city announced that the internal
sentences.zh: 然后在1月20日，即泰里·尼科尔斯去世10天后，市政府宣布孟菲斯警察局的内部

sentences.en: investigation by the Memphis Police Department had been wrapped up and they fired five police officers who had been at the scene that night.
sentences.zh: 调查已经结束，他们解雇了当晚在现场的五名警员。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They said that they had used excessive force.
sentences.zh: 他们表示这些警员过度使用了武力。

sentences.en: They said that they had failed in their duty to intervene and failed in their duty to render aid.
sentences.zh: 他们称警员未履行干预职责，也未履行提供援助的职责。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And in this moment, Rick, when these five officers are fired, what do we learn about them?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一刻，里克，当这五名警员被解雇时，我们对他们了解了多少？

sentences.en: So we learn a few things.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到了一些情况。

sentences.en: We learn that they're all black.
sentences.zh: 我们得知他们都是黑人。

sentences.en: We learn that they're all in their 20s to early 30s.
sentences.zh: 我们得知他们的年龄都在20多岁到30岁出头。

sentences.en: So they're all relatively new to the force, having spent only a few years in the department.
sentences.zh: 所以他们加入警队的时间都相对较短，在部门里只待了几年。

sentences.en: They all joined between 2017 and 2020.
sentences.zh: 他们都是在2017年至2020年期间加入的。

sentences.en: And then we also learned that they're part of a specialized group of officers called the
sentences.zh: 然后我们还了解到，他们是一个名为

sentences.en: Scorpion Unit.
sentences.zh: 蝎子小队（Scorpion Unit）的专业警员小组的成员。

sentences.en: And it's a group that patrols high crime areas of the city where there's been persistent struggles with violence.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在暴力问题持续不断的城市高犯罪率地区进行巡逻的小组。

sentences.en: And it was created in 2021 at a time when the murder rate was climbing, when anxiety over public safety was escalating.
sentences.zh: 它成立于2021年，当时谋杀率正在攀升，公众对公共安全的焦虑情绪不断升级。

sentences.en: And this was kind of cast as like a way to directly combat that by putting these officers out into the streets in these neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 这在当时被认为是一种直接打击犯罪的方式，即把这些警员派上这些社区的街头。

sentences.en: So at this point, what we know is that these five officers are part of an elite unit that seems kind of specially empowered to crack down on crime in Memphis.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，我们知道这五名警员属于一个精英单位，似乎被赋予了在孟菲斯严厉打击犯罪的特殊权力。

sentences.en: And very notably, what we know is that all five of them are black and are accused of ending the life of a black man.
sentences.zh: 非常值得注意的是，我们知道这五个人全都是黑人，却被指控终结了一名黑人的生命。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And at this point, the family launched this effort to really push for, you know, as they see it, getting justice for Tyree.
sentences.zh: 而在此时，家属发起了行动，真正力求为泰里伸张正义。

sentences.en: And the first part of that is just seeing this video, trying to understand how this traffic
sentences.zh: 这其中的第一部分就是观看这段视频，试图理解这次交通

sentences.en: stop went from what seemed like a routine traffic stop and became something so much worse.
sentences.zh: 拦车检查是如何从一起看似常规的盘查演变成如此糟糕的局面的。

sentences.en: And so finally, last Monday, Tyree Nichols' family and their lawyers, they had the chance to finally see the footage for themselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，在上周一，泰里·尼科尔斯的家人和他们的律师终于有机会亲眼看到这段视频。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for allowing us to be in your cathedral to address this injustice.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们允许我们来到你们的大教堂来解决这一不公。

sentences.en: And afterwards, they had a press conference, and that's where we were able to hear some of the first descriptions of what the cameras were able to capture.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他们举行了一场新闻发布会，我们得以在那里听到关于摄像机拍下了什么内容的最初描述。

sentences.en: What we can tell you about the video is it is appalling.
sentences.zh: 关于这段视频，我们能告诉您的是，它令人震惊。

sentences.en: It is deplorable.
sentences.zh: 它令人发指。

sentences.en: It is heinous.
sentences.zh: 它极其残暴。

sentences.en: And it's very troublesome on every level.
sentences.zh: 而且在各个层面都非常令人不安。

sentences.en: The family's attorney, Ben Crump, who is a very prominent civil rights lawyer who represented the family of George Floyd, just talked about how troubling the footage was.
sentences.zh: 家属的律师本·克鲁普是一位非常有名的民权律师，曾代表乔治·弗洛伊德的家属，他谈到了这段录像有多么令人不安。

sentences.en: You know, regrettably, it reminded us of Rodney King video.
sentences.zh: 你知道，遗憾的是，它让我们想起了罗德尼·金的视频。

sentences.en: Regrettably.
sentences.zh: 真令人遗憾。

sentences.en: And unlike Rodney King, Tyree didn't survive.
sentences.zh: 与罗德尼·金不同的是，泰里没有活下来。

sentences.en: Let me say this about Tyree, about what we saw in that video.
sentences.zh: 关于泰里，关于我们在那段视频中看到的一切，让我这样说。

sentences.en: And then one of the family's other lawyers described Tyree Nichols.
sentences.zh: 随后，家属的另一位律师这样描述泰里·尼科尔斯。

sentences.en: He was a human pinata for those police officers.
sentences.zh: 对于那些警察来说，他就像一个活生生的皮纳塔（节日彩罐）。

sentences.en: It was an unadulterated, unabashed, nonstop beating of this young boy for three minutes.
sentences.zh: 这是对这个年轻男孩长达三分钟纯粹的、毫不掩饰的、无休止的殴打。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，我的天哪。

sentences.en: And throughout all of this, you could just hear his mother crying in the background.
sentences.zh: 在这一切过程中，你只能听到他母亲在背景中的哭泣声。

sentences.en: My name is Rovonne Wells, and I'm Tyree's mother.
sentences.zh: 我叫罗冯·韦尔斯，我是泰里的母亲。

sentences.en: My son, I know everybody say they, mothers say they had a good son.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子，我知道每个人都说他们，母亲们都说她们有一个好儿子。

sentences.en: Everybody's son is good.
sentences.zh: 每个人的儿子都是好样的。

sentences.en: But my son, he actually was a good boy.
sentences.zh: 但我的儿子，他实际上真的是个好孩子。

sentences.en: She couldn't make it through the first minute of the video because of just how painful it was to witness that happening to her son.
sentences.zh: 她甚至无法支撑着看完视频的第一分钟，因为目睹这一切发生在自己儿子身上实在是太痛苦了。

sentences.en: I don't have any feelings right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在没有任何感觉。

sentences.en: I don't even know how to, I don't know anything right now.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道该怎么，我现在什么都不知道。

sentences.en: All I know is my son, Tyree, is not here with me anymore.
sentences.zh: 我只知道我的儿子泰里再也不能陪在我身边了。

sentences.en: He will never walk through that door again.
sentences.zh: 他再也不会走进那扇门了。

sentences.en: All my son was trying to do was get home.
sentences.zh: 我儿子当时只想回家。

sentences.en: So at this point, Memphis is learning about this video through the filter of a horrified family.
sentences.zh: 所以在这个时候，孟菲斯是通过一个惊恐万分的家庭的视角来了解这段视频的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then last Thursday, just a few days after the family was able to see the video, local prosecutors announced that the five officers had been charged with second-degree murder
sentences.zh: 然后在上周四，也就是家属看到视频几天后，地方检察官宣布这五名警员被控二级谋杀罪

sentences.en: among other felonies.
sentences.zh: 以及其他重罪。

sentences.en: And with this announcement, we just hear this outpouring of condemnation.
sentences.zh: 随着这一宣布，我们听到了铺天盖地的谴责。

sentences.en: While each of the five individuals played a different role in the incident in question.
sentences.zh: 虽然这五个人中的每个人在涉案事件中都扮演了不同的角色。

sentences.en: From the district attorney.
sentences.zh: 来自地区检察官。

sentences.en: They are all responsible in the death of Tyree Nichols.
sentences.zh: 他们都要对泰里·尼科尔斯的死负责。

sentences.en: From the Memphis police chief.
sentences.zh: 来自孟菲斯警察局长。

sentences.en: This incident was heinous, reckless, and inhumane.
sentences.zh: 这一事件是残暴的、鲁莽的且不人道的。

sentences.en: From the head of the Tennessee Bureau of Investigations.
sentences.zh: 来自田纳西州调查局局长。

sentences.en: Let me be clear.
sentences.zh: 让我明确一点。

sentences.en: What happened here does not at all reflect proper policing.
sentences.zh: 这里发生的事根本不反映正确的警务工作。

sentences.en: This was wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是错误的。

sentences.en: This was criminal.
sentences.zh: 这是犯罪。

sentences.en: This is not just a professional failing.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是职业上的失职。

sentences.en: This is a failing of basic humanity toward another individual.
sentences.zh: 这是对另一个人基本人性的背叛。

sentences.en: And we hear from them that this was a violation of human rights.
sentences.zh: 我们从他们口中听到，这是对人权的侵犯。

sentences.en: And it was a crime.
sentences.zh: 这是一场犯罪。

sentences.en: We all want the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人的诉求都一样。

sentences.en: We want justice for Tyree Nichols.
sentences.zh: 我们要为泰里·尼科尔斯讨回公道。

sentences.en: And yet, with all of these descriptions, we still don't know exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管有所有这些描述，我们仍然不知道究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: We don't know why was Tyree Nichols stopped in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道泰里·尼科尔斯最初为什么会被拦下。

sentences.en: How did he react when the officers stopped him?
sentences.zh: 当警察拦下他时，他是作何反应的？

sentences.en: You know, why did he flee on foot?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他为什么要步行逃跑？

sentences.en: And what did the officers do to Tyree?
sentences.zh: 警察对泰里做了什么？

sentences.en: I mean, we hear that there's been excessive use of force.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们听说存在过度使用武力的情况。

sentences.en: But what does that actually mean?
sentences.zh: 但这实际上意味着什么？

sentences.en: And then, we don't know how long it takes for medical personnel to treat him.
sentences.zh: 还有，我们不知道医护人员花多长时间才对他进行救治。

sentences.en: And we don't know how long it takes before he is taken to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 我们也不知道他被送到医院之前花了多长时间。

sentences.en: There's just so many questions that are still unanswered at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前还有太多的疑问没有答案。

sentences.en: Right, because so far, what's on this video is only really being filtered through first the family, now these city officials, all of whom are saying that they're horrified,
sentences.zh: 没错，因为到目前为止，这段视频里的内容实际上仅仅是通过家属，现在又是这些城市官员进行了过滤，他们都说自己感到震惊，

sentences.en: but the public has yet to see any of the video itself.
sentences.zh: 但公众尚未看到视频本身。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And so, on the same day that the charges are announced against the officers, the city says that the video will finally be released to the public sometime on Friday evening.
sentences.zh: 因此，在宣布对这些警员提出指控的同一天，市政府表示，该视频最终将于周五晚些时候向公众发布。

sentences.en: And so, you know, not only are these officials coming out and saying that they're horrified by the content of the video,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这些官员不仅出来表示他们对视频的内容感到震惊，

sentences.en: they also really express deep concern about the kind of reaction it will provoke in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们还对这会在城里引发何种反应表达了深深的担忧。

sentences.en: The police chief, various elected officials, activists, even, you know, Mr. Nichols' own mother
sentences.zh: 警察局长、各级民选官员、维权人士，甚至尼科尔斯先生自己的母亲

sentences.en: comes out and just implores the community to not let the anger or outrage that they really worry about them having after seeing this,
sentences.zh: 都站出来恳求社区民众，不要让看到视频后产生的担忧引发的愤怒或激愤情绪，

sentences.en: they don't want that to turn into something destructive.
sentences.zh: 演变成某种破坏性的行为。

sentences.en: So, this sense of anticipation and really this sense of anxiety are really building in Memphis now.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种期待感，以及这种焦虑感，现在正在孟菲斯不断积聚。

sentences.en: After-school activities have been closed across the city.
sentences.zh: 全市各地的课后活动已经取消。

sentences.en: Extra law enforcement from around the state has been summoned to Memphis to be on standby.
sentences.zh: 来自全州各地的增援执法力量已被召集到孟菲斯待命。

sentences.en: So, they're prepared to see what happens when people in this city finally have the chance to see this for themselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们正准备面对当这座城市的居民终于有机会亲眼看到这一幕时会发生的情况。

sentences.en: And on Friday night, as promised, the video is released.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上，如约发布了视频。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档聚焦设计之美及相关文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 回想当年黑胶唱片时代的夜店打碟时期，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 把DJ台变成一个像是美丽有50年历史的文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So Rick, walk us through what we see once this video footage is finally released on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 那么里克，给我们讲讲周五晚上这段视频录像最终发布后我们看到了什么。

sentences.en: So it ends up actually being four separate videos that are all posted online and it adds up to roughly an hour of footage.
sentences.zh: 结果实际上是四个独立的视频，全都发布到了网上，加起来大约有一个小时的录像。

sentences.en: It's a combination of footage from body cameras as well as stationary footage from police cameras that are posted around the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这是执法记录仪拍摄的录像，以及街区四周固定的警方摄像头录像的组合。

sentences.en: And so there's just a feed from one of those cameras.
sentences.zh: 这里只有其中一个摄像头的画面。

sentences.en: And it starts in the middle of Tyree Nichols being pulled over.
sentences.zh: 视频从泰瑞·尼科尔斯被拦下中间开始。

sentences.en: So we never actually see the beginning of the stop.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上从未看到拦截的开始。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So while the police have been saying that this was a case of reckless driving,
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然警方一直坚称这是一起危险驾驶案，

sentences.en: we don't actually see that or hear the police telling Tyree Nichols that they're pulling him over for that.
sentences.zh: 但我们实际上并没有看到或听到警察告诉泰瑞·尼科尔斯他们是因为这个拦下他的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the whole reason this all unfolded, like we still don't know the answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 所以整件事发生的整个原因，就像我们仍然不知道那个问题的答案一样。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And so the body camera is on and suddenly the audio kicks in.
sentences.zh: 于是执法记录仪开启，音频突然响起。

sentences.en: And we just see his car in the middle of an intersection at a traffic light and we can see officers, they're running towards his car, their guns are drawn, they're cursing at him,
sentences.zh: 我们只看到他的车停在交通信号灯的十字路口中间，我们可以看到警察正向他的车跑去，他们拔出了枪，对他大骂，

sentences.en: they're telling him to get out and get on the ground.
sentences.zh: 他们叫他滚出来趴在地上。

sentences.en: And he does.
sentences.zh: 他照做了。

sentences.en: You guys are really doing a lot right now.
sentences.zh: 你们现在真的很过分。

sentences.en: Bro, lay down.
sentences.zh: 兄弟，趴下。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to go home.
sentences.zh: 我只是想回家。

sentences.en: Lay down.
sentences.zh: 趴下。

sentences.en: And at one point, he's just lying on the ground pleading, like, I'm just trying to go home.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，他只是趴在地上哀求，就像，我只是想回家。

sentences.en: An officer tries to pepper spray him.
sentences.zh: 一名警察试图向他喷胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: And at that point, he runs.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他跑了。

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不！

sentences.en: Take, take, look!
sentences.zh: 拿，拿，看！

sentences.en: The officer tried to tase him, but he gets away.
sentences.zh: 警察试图用电击枪电击他，但他逃脱了。

sentences.en: And so about eight minutes later...
sentences.zh: 大约八分钟后……

sentences.en: 9.30, we see him.
sentences.zh: 9点30分，我们看到了他。

sentences.en: We're on foot for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对是在步行追踪。

sentences.en: We're putting southbound on rocks.
sentences.zh: 我们正朝着南方的岩石区前进。

sentences.en: The officers catch up to him in a residential area, and he's tackled to the ground.
sentences.zh: 警察在一个居民区追上了他，他被扑倒在地。

sentences.en: You might get sprayed again!
sentences.zh: 你可能会再挨一喷！

sentences.en: The officers pepper spray him.
sentences.zh: 警察向他喷胡椒喷雾。

sentences.en: They hit and kick him.
sentences.zh: 他们殴打并踢他。

sentences.en: You can see him being kicked in the head.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到他的头部被踢。

sentences.en: Watch out!
sentences.zh: 小心！

sentences.en: I'm a baton the fuck out of you!
sentences.zh: 我他妈要用警棍狠狠地揍你！

sentences.en: He the fuck is!
sentences.zh: 他他妈是的！

sentences.en: You can see him being hit with batons.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到他被警棍击打。

sentences.en: Part of the reason that we're able to see this is not just because it's the up-close kind of shaky body camera footage.
sentences.zh: 我们之所以能看到这一点，不仅仅是因为这是那种近距离晃动的执法记录仪画面。

sentences.en: We actually have this bird's-eye view from the street camera that just is able to capture everything as it's happening from above.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上拥有来自街头摄像头的上帝视角，它能够从上方捕捉到事发时的所有画面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And at one point, they stand him up, and an officer punches him repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 而且有一会儿，他们让他站起来，一名警察多次殴打他。

sentences.en: The beating lasts about three minutes, and throughout it, you can just hear his cries of anguish.
sentences.zh: 殴打持续了大约三分钟，期间你只能听到他痛苦的哭喊。

sentences.en: At one point, you can hear him crying out for his mom.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，你能听到他大声呼唤他的妈妈。

sentences.en: He says, Mom, Mom, Mom.
sentences.zh: 他说，妈妈，妈妈，妈妈。

sentences.en: And her home is maybe a hundred yards away.
sentences.zh: 而她的家可能就在一百码之外。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's very difficult footage to watch.
sentences.zh: 这段录像非常难看下去。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's a lot to take in.
sentences.zh: 信息量太大了，难以承受。

sentences.en: Eventually, you know, the officers prop him up against the police car.
sentences.zh: 最终，你知道，警察把他靠在警车上撑着。

sentences.en: He slumps over.
sentences.zh: 他瘫倒下去。

sentences.en: I ain't even good.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不好了。

sentences.en: Look, we got him out of the car.
sentences.zh: 看，我们把他从车里拉出来了。

sentences.en: We was like, hey, bro, you good?
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，嘿，兄弟，你还好吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to swam.
sentences.zh: 我要……

sentences.en: Bow!
sentences.zh: 砰！

sentences.en: I'm going to hit me.
sentences.zh: 你要打我。

sentences.en: And then you reach for more gun.
sentences.zh: 然后你伸手去够更多的枪。

sentences.en: You slam him to the car, and you're like, oh, no.
sentences.zh: 你把他猛推到车上，然后你说，哦，不。

sentences.en: He literally had his hand on my gun.
sentences.zh: 他 literalmente 把手放在我的枪上了。

sentences.en: Like, that motherfucker's on there.
sentences.zh: 就像，那个混蛋就在那上面。

sentences.en: And you can hear officers saying that he reached for one of their guns, or he tried to take a swing at them.
sentences.zh: 你可以听到警察说他去抓他们的枪，或者他试图向他们挥拳。

sentences.en: But those are things that we actually don't see in the video.
sentences.zh: 但这些其实我们在视频中都没有看到。

sentences.en: I mean, other than him running after the stop, like, we don't really see any resistance.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，除了他在被拦截后逃跑之外，我们真的没有看到任何抵抗。

sentences.en: There's really no evidence that we can see from the videos of him fighting back.
sentences.zh: 从视频中我们看不到他进行反抗的任何实质证据。

sentences.en: They also said that they thought that he was high, but there was no real evidence, it seemed, so far, to back that up.
sentences.zh: 他们还说他们认为他嗑药了，但似乎没有什么真实的证据来支持这一点。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So the officers appear at a couple of different moments here to be trying to justify their actions, even though the footage doesn't really support the actions.
sentences.zh: 因此，在这里的几个不同时刻，警察似乎都在试图为他们的行为辩解，尽管录像并没有真正支持这些行为。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then a couple of minutes later, you have emergency responders arrive at the scene.
sentences.zh: 然后在几分钟后，你看到急救人员抵达现场。

sentences.en: There are two medics from the fire department.
sentences.zh: 消防部门来了两名医疗人员。

sentences.en: They look at Nichols, but you can see they're not administering any care.
sentences.zh: 他们看了看尼科尔斯，但你能看出他们没有进行任何救治。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I remember watching it and kind of counting the number of people on the scene.
sentences.zh: 我记得看的时候数了数现场的人数。

sentences.en: It's upwards of 10, none of whom appear to be doing anything to attend to Tyree Nichols.
sentences.zh: 足有10人以上，但似乎没有人做任何事情来照顾泰瑞·尼科尔斯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: He's just sitting by that car for more than 24 minutes before an ambulance arrives.
sentences.zh: 他在那辆车旁边坐了24分钟多，救护车才赶到。

sentences.en: And occasionally, Nichols slumps over by the car and they prop him up.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，尼科尔斯在车旁瘫倒，他们又把他扶起来。

sentences.en: So thinking back to those questions, Rick, that we all had before the footage was released, it does seem like a lot of them were answered in these videos.
sentences.zh: 所以回想一下视频发布前我们都有的那些问题，里克，其中许多问题似乎确实在这些视频中得到了解答。

sentences.en: Because we see these officers really aggressively approach Tyree Nichols' vehicle, pull him to the ground.
sentences.zh: 因为我们看到这些警察非常咄咄逼人地靠近泰瑞·尼科尔斯的车，把他拉倒在地。

sentences.en: He runs, we don't know why, but he does not fight back at any point, as you said.
sentences.zh: 他跑了，我们不知道为什么，但他正如你所说，在任何时候都没有反抗。

sentences.en: We hear the officers at one point expressing an intent to hurt him.
sentences.zh: 我们听到警察在某一时刻表达了伤害他的意图。

sentences.en: We then clearly see that they're using a tremendous amount of force against this person who's not fighting back.
sentences.zh: 然后我们清楚地看到，他们对这个没有反抗的人使用了极大的武力。

sentences.en: And we later hear the officers offering a justification or a set of justifications for their actions after the fact in ways that don't really line up with what we see in the videos.
sentences.zh: 我们后来听到警察事后为他们的行为提供了一个或一套辩解，这与我们在视频中所看到的并不真正相符。

sentences.en: And finally, we see the police and these medics showing very little regard for Tyree Nichols' injuries or his well-being, despite the fact that he's visibly and audibly in pain.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们看到警察和这些医护人员对泰瑞·尼科尔斯的伤势或福祉表现出极大的冷漠，尽管事实上他明显且痛苦地在呻吟。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's why so many of the people I've talked to said that they found the video as disturbing and as infuriating as the family made it out to be.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我交谈过的许多人表示，他们觉得这段视频和家属所说的一样令人不安和愤怒。

sentences.en: Not just the brutality on display and the beating, but also what they saw as the callousness in the waiting around that came after.
sentences.zh: 不仅是展示的残暴和殴打，还有他们所看到的随后来临的等待中的冷酷无情。

sentences.en: So I want to turn to how people in Memphis have reacted to this footage,
sentences.zh: 所以我想转向孟菲斯人对这段视频的反应，

sentences.en: given all the anxiety that was expressed by both city officials and Tyree Nichols' family over what the reaction would look like.
sentences.zh: 鉴于城市官员和泰瑞·尼科尔斯的家属对反应会是什么样表达了所有的焦虑。

sentences.en: There was pain.
sentences.zh: 有痛苦。

sentences.en: There was anger.
sentences.zh: 有愤怒。

sentences.en: Many people in Memphis watched the footage, but there were also others that didn't, that couldn't.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯的许多人观看了录像，但也有其他人没有看，也无法看。

sentences.en: They felt that whatever they would learn wouldn't be outweighed by the trauma they'd inflict by seeing something like this.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得无论他们能了解到什么，都无法抵消看到这样的事情所带来的心理创伤。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And there were protests in Atlanta, New York, Los Angeles, Seattle, Washington, D.C., and in Memphis, too.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大、纽约、洛杉矶、西雅图、华盛顿特区以及孟菲斯也爆发了抗议活动。

sentences.en: You had dozens come out on Friday nights.
sentences.zh: 周五晚上有几十人走上街头。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: They blocked off an interstate, then they closed off a bridge, but things wrapped up peacefully before too long.
sentences.zh: 他们封锁了一条州际公路，然后封闭了一座桥，但事情不久后就和平结束了。

sentences.en: And it was sort of the same on Saturday, where it was a modest showing, but there were people that came out and demanded justice.
sentences.zh: 周六的情况也差不多，规模适中，但确实有人走出来要求伸张正义。

sentences.en: Is there a sense that the way the city of Memphis has handled this case so far and what looks to be a real determination to get the wheels of justice in motion so quickly,
sentences.zh: 人们是否有一种感觉，即孟菲斯市迄今为止处理此案的方式以及对迅速推动正义车轮转动的真正决心，

sentences.en: that that may help explain why the reaction has been what it's been, which is to say peaceful and, to a degree, a little understated?
sentences.zh: 这可能有助于解释为什么反应会是现在这样——也就是和平的，并且在某种程度上有点低调？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I mean, Ben Crump, the lawyer for the family, said at a press conference before the tape came out on Friday that this should be the blueprint, America, is what he said.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，家属的律师本·克鲁普在周五录像发布前的新闻发布会上说，这应该是美国的蓝图，他是这么说的。

sentences.en: He talked about how swiftly officials moved here to fire the officers, how swiftly they moved to bring criminal charges all in less than a month.
sentences.zh: 他谈到官员们在这里以多快的速度采取行动解雇警察，以多快的速度在不到一个月的时间内提起刑事指控。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm curious, as we think about how people are reacting to this all, how folks are thinking about what has been really a central element of what happened to Tyree Nichols,
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，当我们思考人们对此作何反应时，大家是如何看待这起事件中泰瑞·尼科尔斯遭遇的一个核心要素的，

sentences.en: and something that's different about this case from a lot of the cases of alleged police brutality that we have focused on in this country,
sentences.zh: 这也是本案与我们在国内关注的许多所谓的警察暴力执法案件有所不同的一点，

sentences.en: which is that he is a Black man who was allegedly killed by five Black police officers.
sentences.zh: 即他是一个据称被五名黑人警察杀害的黑人男子。

sentences.en: And as painfully familiar as we have become with Black men dying at the hands of the police,
sentences.zh: 正如我们对黑人男子死于警察之手变得痛苦地熟悉一样，

sentences.en: typically in these cases that get a lot of attention, it's been at the hands of white police officers.
sentences.zh: 通常在这些引起广泛关注的案件中，凶手都是白人警察。

sentences.en: So we're a little less prepared for all the officers to be Black.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对所有警察都是黑人有点准备不足。

sentences.en: So how are people thinking about that, and how are they making sense of it?
sentences.zh: 那么人们是如何看待这一点的，他们是如何理解它的？

sentences.en: Well, it's very complicated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这非常复杂。

sentences.en: One of the prevailing sentiments that I hear in Memphis is just this sense of sadness over all of this.
sentences.zh: 我在孟菲斯听到的普遍情绪之一就是对这一切的悲伤感。

sentences.en: One of my colleagues spoke to a woman who just, she saw the photos of the officers on TV, and she was just disappointed.
sentences.zh: 我的一位同事与一位女士交谈过，她只是在电视上看到了这些警察的照片，她感到非常失望。

sentences.en: You know, how could you do this, she asked.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你怎么能做出这种事，她问道。

sentences.en: Memphis, it's a majority Black city, and it has a majority Black police force.
sentences.zh: 孟菲斯是一个黑人占多数的城市，并且拥有一个黑人占多数的警察队伍。

sentences.en: And, you know, the idea has been that if you have a police force whose demographics match those of the city,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，大家的想法一直是，如果你拥有一支警局人口统计数据与城市相符的警察队伍，

sentences.en: that it could make a difference, that it could make policing more effective, that it could really reduce the tensions that endure between the community and law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这可能会有所不同，这可能会使警务工作更有效，这确实可以减少社区与执法部门之间持续存在的紧张关系。

sentences.en: Right, and potentially prevent things like this from happening, what happened in this case.
sentences.zh: 对，并有可能防止发生像这样的事情，在这起案件中发生的事情。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And so this was an instance where that mode of thinking didn't really bear out.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个这种思维方式并没有真正实现的情况。

sentences.en: And so what I hear from many of the people that you talk to here is that, yes, there is a lot of anger and frustration directed at these five officers.
sentences.zh: 因此，我从这里交谈的许多人那里听到的是，是的，有很多人对这五名警察感到愤怒和沮丧。

sentences.en: But they see this as an indictment of a system and of a culture that surrounds policing so that the race of the officers doesn't actually make that much of a difference.
sentences.zh: 但他们将此视为对警察制度和围绕警务工作的文化的控诉，因此警察的种族实际上并没有那么大差别。

sentences.en: That the divisions between the police and the community just still remain the same.
sentences.zh: 警察与社区之间的鸿沟依然如故。

sentences.en: Right, the question I think a lot of people are asking in the wake of what happened to Tyree Nichols
sentences.zh: 对，我想很多人在泰瑞·尼科尔斯遭遇不幸后都在问的问题是，

sentences.en: is whether there's something about policing, something fundamental that occurs when officers
sentences.zh: 警务工作本身是否有某种问题，某种当警察穿上那身制服时发生的根本性问题，

sentences.en: put on that uniform, given the nature of modern policing, that somehow encourages brutality,
sentences.zh: 鉴于现代警务工作的性质，不知何故鼓励了暴力的发生，

sentences.en: especially toward Black people, but not just toward them, and regardless of the race of the officers.
sentences.zh: 特别是针对黑人，但不仅限于他们，并且与警察的种族无关。

sentences.en: Exactly, and that's really what has made this so much more complicated.
sentences.zh: 没错，这正是让这件事变得如此复杂的原因。

sentences.en: So Rick, what happens now in Memphis?
sentences.zh: 那么里克，孟菲斯现在会发生什么？

sentences.en: What do we expect the next few weeks to look like in this case?
sentences.zh: 我们预计本案在未来几周会有什么进展？

sentences.en: The mayor, the police chief have all committed to really kind of digging in and examining
sentences.zh: 市长和警察局长都承诺会深入调查并探讨

sentences.en: how do you prevent something like this from happening and how do you build something better?
sentences.zh: 如何防止此类事件再次发生，以及如何建立更好的机制？

sentences.en: And, you know, one of the first steps of that was on Saturday, the police chief said that she had
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，其中的第一步发生在周六，警察局长表示她已经

sentences.en: disbanded the Scorpion unit, the specialized group of which these five officers had been a part of.
sentences.zh: 解散了蝎子小队，这五名涉案警官此前就是该专业小组的成员。

sentences.en: And so there's still the investigations about what actually happened at the scene.
sentences.zh: 因此，关于现场究竟发生了什么，目前仍在调查中。

sentences.en: You know, those two medics who responded to the call and were seen not doing very much in the video, they were relieved of duty by the fire department.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那两名赶到现场但在视频中看起来无所作为的医护人员，已经被消防部门免职了。

sentences.en: And there's an investigation about whether, you know, they should be fired or face other consequences.
sentences.zh: 目前正在调查他们是否应该被解雇或面临其他后果。

sentences.en: Tyree Nichols' family believes that they should be criminally charged.
sentences.zh: 泰瑞·尼科尔斯的家人认为他们应该受到刑事指控。

sentences.en: Two sheriff's deputies have also been relieved of duty.
sentences.zh: 两名治安官副官也被免职了。

sentences.en: As the sheriff's department here tries to figure out what they were doing at the scene, there's a separate federal civil rights investigation that's happening.
sentences.zh: 正当此处的治安官办公室试图弄清楚他们在现场的行为时，一项独立的联邦民权调查也在进行中。

sentences.en: And then there's the case against the five officers who were charged with second-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 接下来是对这五名被控二级谋杀的警官的诉讼案件。

sentences.en: You know, the prosecution is moving forward with them, and it could very well head to trial.
sentences.zh: 检察机关正在推进此案，而且很有可能会进入审判阶段。

sentences.en: Rick, have the five officers or lawyers for them said anything in their defense?
sentences.zh: 里克，这五名警官或他们的律师有没有为自己说些什么？

sentences.en: Well, the main thing is they've just pleaded with the public to avoid arrest to judgment, and they've made the case that the video does not tell you everything,
sentences.zh: 嗯，最主要的是他们恳请公众不要过早下定论，并提出视频并不能说明全部情况，

sentences.en: and that the public should not base their opinions entirely upon what they see in that video.
sentences.zh: 公众不应该完全根据他们在视频中看到的内容来形成看法。

sentences.en: You know, just as we don't know what initiated the stop, there may be other factors, potentially, is what these lawyers are saying,
sentences.zh: 正如我们不知道是什么引发了拦截一样，这些律师表示，可能还存在其他因素

sentences.en: that just aren't reflected in the footage that we saw.
sentences.zh: 只是没有在我们看到的录像中反映出来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It strikes me that Memphis is about to go through what many cities in the U.S., like Minneapolis and Ferguson and Baltimore, have gone through after a case like this,
sentences.zh: 给我的感觉是，孟菲斯即将经历许多美国城市（如明尼阿波利斯、弗格森和巴尔的摩）在经历此类案件后所经历的过程，

sentences.en: which is first a trauma, right, a kind of collective trauma around an alleged case of police brutality
sentences.zh: 也就是首先是创伤，对吧，围绕一起据称是警察暴力的事件产生的一种集体创伤，

sentences.en: that ends in the death of a Black man, and then a trial that very painfully relives it all.
sentences.zh: 最终导致一名黑人死亡，然后是一场痛苦地重温这一切的审判。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's going to be a long road.
sentences.zh: 这将是一段漫长的道路。

sentences.en: So, when I talk to people in the community, there is this sense of skepticism that still really lingers, because, yes, there have been charges, there have been firings,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我与社区居民交谈时，仍然能感觉到一种挥之不去的怀疑态度，因为没错，已经有人被起诉，有人被解雇，

sentences.en: there have been changes in police department policy.
sentences.zh: 警察局的政策也发生了变化。

sentences.en: As Crump was saying that there is this blueprint now.
sentences.zh: 正如克朗普所说，现在已经有了这样一个蓝图。

sentences.en: There is a blueprint, but it's like the house isn't built.
sentences.zh: 蓝图是有了，但感觉房子还没建好。

sentences.en: That's the feeling.
sentences.zh: 这就是大家的感受。

sentences.en: It's that, you know, what happens with the trial?
sentences.zh: 也就是，审判结果会怎样？

sentences.en: What happens ultimately with the police department?
sentences.zh: 警察局最终会变成什么样？

sentences.en: And what I hear, especially from people that are really invested in this case, they know that it's going to take vigilance,
sentences.zh: 我听到的话，尤其是从那些真正投入到这个案件中的人那里听到的，他们知道这需要保持警惕，

sentences.en: because it really is a long road ahead to get to the place where they want the city to be.
sentences.zh: 因为要达到他们希望这座城市成为的样子，前方确实还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: And that's with a better police department and with these officers being held accountable.
sentences.zh: 那就是拥有一个更好的警察局，并且让这些警官承担责任。

sentences.en: Well, Rick, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，里克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Sunday, violence erupted in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, where Israeli settlers carried out dozens of attacks against Palestinians and their property.
sentences.zh: 周日，以色列占领的约旦河西岸爆发了暴力冲突，以色列定居者对巴勒斯坦人及其财产发动了数十起袭击。

sentences.en: It was the latest in a series of deadly clashes that began last Thursday, when the Israeli military staged a raid in which 10 people were killed.
sentences.zh: 这是自上周四以色列军队发动导致10人死亡的突袭以来，一系列致命冲突中的最新一起。

sentences.en: Israel said that the raid was a counterterrorism operation aimed at Islamic jihadists planning attacks against Israeli targets.
sentences.zh: 以色列表示，此次突袭是一项反恐行动，旨在打击策划针对以色列目标袭击的伊斯兰圣战分子。

sentences.en: The next day, a Palestinian gunman killed seven people outside a synagogue in a Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 次日，一名巴勒斯坦枪手在东耶路撒冷一个犹太人定居点的一座犹太教堂外枪杀七人。

sentences.en: Overall, at least 20 people have died over the past four days.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，过去四天里至少已有20人丧生。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由黛安娜·阮制作，

sentences.zh: 穆杰·扎迪和玛丽·威尔逊制作。

sentences.zh: 节目由安妮塔·巴达霍编辑，约翰·凯彻姆、

sentences.en: Lisa Chow, and Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·周和佩奇·考维特提供了帮助。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lanthvork of Wonder League.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由奇异联盟的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰特沃克创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时甚至扣人心弦的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都会》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都会》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下次再见。
